mission: The seal's deterioration reaches beyond the Corridor — reports filter in of disturbances at known Force nexuses. The Valley of the Jedi at Ruusan is affected. The crisis is no longer local.
why_now: Escalation — the wound's effects are spreading. What was contained is leaking into the wider galaxy.
conflict: Ben receives fragmentary reports through the Steady Returns' limited comms. Jedi outposts reporting anomalous Force behavior. The Valley of the Jedi — the most symbolically important Force site connected to the Reformations — is destabilizing.
turning_point: The Valley's destabilization is directly connected to the seal — the Reformations and the seal were built on the same historical event. As the seal fails, the Valley's trapped Force energy is responding.
opening_hook: Ben cycles through comm channels and catches fragmentary reports he can only half-decrypt — Jedi outposts at multiple nexuses reporting anomalous Force behavior. The wrongness isn't just here anymore.
closing_hook: Luke's personal message, brief and coded: 'Sensing disturbances at multiple nexuses. Report status.' Ben stares at the message for a long time. He doesn't answer.
emotional_trajectory: Strategic alarm -> scope expanding -> the weight of withholding from Luke deepening

stakes.personal: Ben's institutional lie becoming harder to maintain as the crisis affects the broader Order
stakes.interpersonal: The group recognizing that their local mission has galaxy-wide consequences
stakes.external: The seal's failure is affecting Force nexuses across the galaxy

setting: Aboard the Steady Returns — comm station, hyperspace transit
sensory_details: Static-filled comm intercepts; Luke's message — brief, controlled, concerned; Ben's datapad with the unanswered reply draft; the wrongness now a constant background note, no longer surprising but permanent
action_beats: Ben cycles through comm frequencies and catches fragmentary distress reports from Jedi outposts across the galaxy
Desh pulls up a galactic map and plots each reported disturbance — the pattern radiating outward from the Corridor
Luke's coded message arrives on Ben's personal frequency and Ben stares at the reply field without typing
notes: SP4 (institutional lie) intensifying — Ben's withholding from Luke is becoming active deception as the crisis expands. The parallel to Gavran's secrecy should be felt by the reader.
